intro: Dongers are elaborate, arm-raising text faces — the heavy-duty cousins of the Lenny face, made famous by the Twitch "raise your dongers" meme ヽ༼ຈل͜ຈ༽ﾉ. A donger is plain Unicode text built from Thai, Tibetan, and other script marks, so it pastes cleanly into Discord, Twitch chat, comments, and bios. Browse raise-your-dongers, flexing, marching, and angry dongers below and click any to copy it instantly.
